title: SOC2 prep scratchpad - Carter Nguyen
content:
Quick scratchpad for SOC2 prep - rough notes, owner q's, and short-term todo list.

Context:
- Goal: Make a prioritized list of controls we need to evidence for Type 2 readiness for our inference platform offering (hosted + dedicated + private).
- Focus first on CC6 (change management), CC7 (system operations), CC3 (access control) evidence gaps.
- This is messy - use as working notes for alignment w/ Maya, Lena, and Eng leads.

High-level open questions / assumptions:
- Do we consider Dedicated customers under the same org boundary or separate for evidence? (Assume same control universe but with separate configs for Private.)
- Backup retention policy: is it documented centrally or split by infra teams? Need source of truth.
- Which logging pipeline retains immutable logs for 12 months? SRE/observability probably owns, but need exact retention window.

Immediate evidence gaps I think we need to collect:
1) Access control (CC3)
   - Current: SSO + SCIM for console; API key issuance for hosted API.
   - Gaps: API key lifecycle docs (rotation policy, expired key handling). No documented periodic review process for service accounts.
   - Action: ask DevOps to export list of service principals + owners. Owner: Lena. Due: 2026-02-28.

2) Change management (CC6)
   - Current: GitHub PRs, codeowners, and gated CI. Release notes live in release-engineering.
   - Gaps: Formal change window calendar and emergency change procedure doc (we have partial notes in release handbook). Need evidence of approvals for production-impacting releases over last 6 months.
   - Action: collect PR approvals and link to release tickets. Owner: Oliver. Due: 2026-03-05.

3) System operations / monitoring (CC7)
   - Current: Datadog + internal traces; alert runbooks exist but some are scattered in SRE wiki.
   - Gaps: Evidence of alert tuning and incident postmortems mapped to alerts. Need retention policy for traces.
   - Action: SRE to provide list of incidents and postmortems for last 12 months. Owner: Maya. Due: 2026-03-03.

4) Encryption & Key management (CC5)
   - Current: KMS integrations for Private (customer-managed optional). Hosted uses cloud KMS.
   - Gaps: Key rotation schedule doc and proof of rotations for keys used in prod inference runtime.
   - Action: Security to extract KMS audit logs for last 12 months. Owner: Security team (coordinate w/ me).

Quick control mapping fragments (work-in-progress):
- CC3.1: user account provisioning -> evidence: SCIM sync logs, onboarding checklist, HR sync ticket IDs.
- CC6.2: change approvals -> evidence: GitHub PRs with approvals + Jira release ticket + release sign-off email thread.
- CC7.4: incident detection -> evidence: Datadog alert history + postmortem docs + timeline.

Immediate TODOs (short):
- [ ] Draft cover matrix: control -> artifact -> owner -> sample date (template ready). Owner: Carter. Due: 2026-02-23.
- [ ] Request service account inventory from infra. Owner: Lena. Due: 2026-02-28.
- [ ] Pull PR approvals for prod-impacting repos (serving-runtime, release-engineering). Owner: Oliver. Due: 2026-03-05.
- [ ] Compile list of incidents and postmortems (SRE). Owner: Maya. Due: 2026-03-03.

Notes to self / meeting reminders:
- Sync with Maya/Lena/Oliver - propose 30m weekly on Mondays until evidence baseline complete.
- Need to confirm whether Dedicated reservations qualify as separate tenant for some controls - ask Product (dedicated team).
- Keep copies of any exported CSVs in a secure folder (link to Evidence bucket once set up).

Potential risks / blockers:
- Teams may be overloaded and not have historical exports readily available (PRs, logs). Might need to offer to pull/generate artifacts.
- Some artifacts are stored in customer-specific Private deployments (on-prem); need to clarify scope for audit.

Example sample artifact list to request from teams:
- SCIM audit CSV (timestamp, actor, action)
- IAM role change logs (cloud provider)
- KMS key rotation events / audit entries
- PR approvals + merge commits for prod releases (last 6 months)
- Datadog alert firing events with incident link

Rough timeline (proposal):
- Week 1 (now -> Mar 3): collect primary artifacts for CC3/CC6/CC7 (owners above)
- Week 2 (Mar 4 -> Mar 10): fill cover matrix, identify missing artifacts, prepare replacements (screenshots, exports)
- Week 3 (Mar 11 -> Mar 17): engage external auditor with sample artifacts, iterate on gaps

Thoughts: keep this doc as the single scratchpad. When something is finalized, move it into Confluence (link in linked_artifacts).

Unresolved questions to ask auditor / compliance lead:
- Do we need separate evidence for Dedicated vs Hosted for encryption keys?
- Minimum retention window for logs/traces required by SOC2 Type 2? (I think 12 months but confirm.)
- Acceptable formats for evidence (CSV vs screenshots) - prefer CSVs with metadata.

-- end scratchpad --
